none: PAS LON-5D9DEB: Incomplete Roman nummus of the House of Constantine, AD.317-364.
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

Incomplete Roman nummus of the House of Constantine, AD.317-364. Reverse, two winged victories holding shield inscribed VOT PR, over an altar, legend VICTORIA LAETAE PRIN[CPERP]. Coin is quite worn and damaged around the edge with corrosion on the obverse. Weight: 1.66g. Diameter: 15.19mm
